summary: The minor has no fixed course list: you propose a study list of at least six courses of at least 3 units each, totaling at least 24 units and not taken for your major, and move the courses in once the minor advisor approves it. Each of the six must be letter graded, and any further approved courses go under Other approved courses; if a course you need offers no letter grade, mark the requirement met once your advisor approves. Your advisor also checks the 2.0 GPA in the minor's courses and any transfer credit.

ydcmTfTz.why: "An Environmental Systems Engineering minor must contain at least 24 units of coursework not taken for the major and consist of at least six classes of at least three units each of letter-graded work"; students "obtain his approval of the finalized study list". No list, so the student moves the approved courses in; Each course must be letter graded (Grading: "Complete at least six classes of at least three units each of letter-graded work, except where letter grades are not offered"); a course with no letter-grade option is marked met by hand. Approved courses beyond the six, which the text does not require to be letter graded, go in the optional rule beside it and count toward the 24 units.
